gloss: on the sea; offshore; on the ocean

definitions.gloss: on the sea; offshore; on the open ocean
definitions.explanation: The area on or above the open sea. Frequently used in contexts such as offshore wind power, naval operations, and marine incidents.

examples.japanese: {洋上|ようじょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}まる→強まる：02295_tsuyomaru⟧。
examples.english: The wind grows stronger out at sea.

notes:
A somewhat formal noun for the open sea, most often heard now in {洋上|ようじょう}⟦{風力|ふうりょく}{発電|はつでん}→風力発電：08742_fuuryokuhatsuden⟧ (offshore wind power).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {洋上|ようじょう}⟦{風力|ふうりょく}{発電|はつでん}→風力発電：08742_fuuryokuhatsuden⟧: offshore wind power generation
- {洋上|ようじょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: to go out onto the open sea

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{海上|かいじょう}→海上：09799_kaijou⟧: on the sea — more everyday and general; {洋上|ようじょう} emphasizes the open ocean, far from land
